notes: Sheet between Auburn (sheet 183) and Burnet. Helen ('HELEN', 50', pipe; lines y ~394/566) runs across the top. 'MAPLEWOOD AV. (NELSON AV.)' (50', pipe x ~1703) runs from Helen (T: sheet 193 block line closes it on the north) south to Earnshaw, where it ends. 'HIGHLAND AV.' (60') and 'BURNET AV.' (50') cross Helen: north of Helen both continue NNW on sheets 193/194 (only outlined here: Highland's north arm centre x ~2677 at Helen's north line, Burnet's ~3681), so both bend slightly at the Helen crossing; sheets 193 and 194 print the north arms as HIGHLAND AV. and BURNET AV. 'McGREGOR AV.' (60', lines y ~1610/1820) crosses all three. 'GILMAN AV.' (50') runs from the left edge to a T on Maplewood; Albion Place ('ALBION PL.', 35') comes in from sheet 183 along the left edge, curves south and T's into Gilman (the same Albion/Gilman junction as on sheet 183, here at x 450). 'EARNSHAW' (no suffix; named Earnshaw Street, as on sheet 183, to keep it apart from Earnshaw Avenue (Superior)) jogs about 140 px at Maplewood: the west leg is centred y ~4090 and the east leg y ~4225, and Maplewood's 50 ft pipe turns into the east leg; the Maplewood/Earnshaw point is the centre of the open junction (between y 4003 and 4319) and the two leg ends are listed as bends. Highland and Burnet both continue south of Earnshaw (crossings). No alleys on this sheet.
